components.name: Base utilities
components.logic_status: Some local feature slices configured-validated in Rust; substantial C++ subsystem policy remains
components.remaining_work: Byte/number/IP/address utilities, buffers, errors, feature configuration, URL/filename/MIME helpers; split by API family before assignment.
components.seams: base task runners, time, strings, refcounts, FilePath; url GURL and ICU

components.name: DNS
components.logic_status: Some local feature slices configured-validated in Rust; substantial C++ subsystem policy remains
components.remaining_work: DNS names then wire records, transaction/session cache, resolver jobs, configuration/watchers and mDNS.
components.seams: OS resolver services, sockets, base callbacks and URL host canonicalization

components.name: Authentication
components.logic_status: Some local feature slices configured-validated in Rust; substantial C++ subsystem policy remains
components.remaining_work: Challenge/token parsers, schemes and caches, NTLM, negotiate and credential ownership.
components.seams: SSPI/GSSAPI, crypto/BoringSSL, platform credentials

components.name: HTTP
components.logic_status: Some local feature slices configured-validated in Rust; substantial C++ subsystem policy remains
components.remaining_work: Headers/status/range/content parsers first; streams, transactions, sessions, cache orchestration and transport security state later.
components.seams: C++ session graphs, callbacks, URL, sockets, cert verification, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3

components.name: Sockets
components.remaining_work: Address-independent buffers/state then connect jobs, pools, TCP/UDP and per-platform IO.
components.seams: Winsock/IOCP, POSIX descriptors, event loop, socket handles and cancel semantics

components.name: SSL and certificates
components.remaining_work: DER/policy/cache first, verifier and trust stores, SSL client/server config and stream ownership next.
components.seams: crypto, BoringSSL, OS trust/key stores, network revocation fetching through URLRequest (runtime cycle)

components.name: Cookies
components.remaining_work: Canonicalization, inclusion policy, partitioning, store and async persistence.
components.seams: url/site semantics, PSL, base time, SQLite in extras

components.name: Disk cache
components.remaining_work: Key/index formats and eviction then blockfile/simple backends, async operations/recovery.
components.seams: base files/task runners, memory mapping, filesystem crash consistency

components.name: Proxy and PAC
components.remaining_work: Config/rules/bypass first; resolution service, PAC execution/fetch, auth and platform discovery later.
components.seams: OS proxy APIs, Mojo/browser PAC execution beyond net, URLRequest fetch runtime cycle

components.name: QUIC integration
components.remaining_work: Chromium QUIC sessions, stream factories, pools, crypto client config and migration policy.
components.seams: QUICHE external protocol implementation and BoringSSL; not considered rewritten

components.name: HTTP/2 integration
components.remaining_work: Chromium HTTP/2 session, stream ownership, flow control and protocol adaptation.
components.seams: QUICHE spdy/http2 codecs, C++ network session

components.name: WebSockets
components.remaining_work: Frame/mask codecs first, stream state machine and handshake, HTTP2/3 integration next.
components.seams: HTTP streams, socket/SSL ownership and callback cancellation

components.name: URLRequest
components.logic_status: Some local feature slices configured-validated in Rust; substantial C++ subsystem policy remains
components.remaining_work: Jobs, redirects, delegates, interceptors, request context and lifetime ownership.
components.seams: embedder delegates and network service/browser consumers outside net

components.name: Device-bound sessions
components.remaining_work: Registration/challenge parsing then session/store/refresh state and request integration.
components.seams: crypto unexportable keys, platform keystores, protobuf storage and URLRequest runtime cycle

components.name: Content filters
components.logic_status: Some local feature slices configured-validated in Rust; substantial C++ subsystem policy remains
components.remaining_work: gzip framing then filter state machines and output buffer ownership.
components.seams: zlib/Brotli/Zstd external codec APIs; algorithms remain external until separately ported

components.name: Logging
components.remaining_work: Event types/values first; NetLog observer, capture, file writer and redaction ownership later.
components.seams: base Value/time/observers/files, tracing/perfetto consumers

components.name: Reporting and network error logging
components.remaining_work: Policies/cache/batching then upload/service lifecycle and persistence.
components.seams: URLRequest upload and SQLite persistence, timers, privacy partition keys

components.name: Network quality estimation
components.remaining_work: Observations/estimators then watcher/platform integration and persistence.
components.seams: OS notifications, base clocks/histograms and network-change notifier

components.name: Shared dictionaries
components.remaining_work: Isolation keys/metadata then storage/read/write and decoding lifecycle.
components.seams: external codecs and disk/cache ownership

components.name: Platform integration
components.remaining_work: JNI and platform services; platform-specific files elsewhere retain their subsystem owner.
components.seams: Android Java/JNI; Windows, Apple, Linux, Fuchsia require separate configured builds

components.name: Server support
components.remaining_work: HTTP server connection/parser state then websocket upgrade and IO lifetimes.
components.seams: socket event loop and consumer callbacks

components.name: Tests/tools/support
components.remaining_work: Port test harnesses and command tools; persistence adapters in extras are production support and must migrate too.
components.seams: gtest/fuzztest, Python, SQLite, protobuf generators; not all support files are production

components.name: External vendored sources
components.remaining_work: Inventory QUICHE, URI template and Mozilla security/Windows code separately; audit upgrade and replacement strategy.
components.seams: External does not mean excluded from eventual full-codebase project

components.name: Root build/config/support
components.remaining_work: Root C++/headers and generated inputs require explicit allocation before implementation; root glob is last and covers no unassigned directory today.
components.seams: Parent owns shared GN/build/configuration and integration
